concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 1.3 First‑Arrival Derivation & Feature Engineering (T015) → Phase 2 Modeling & Validation (T024/T024‑sens)
concerns.text: The secondary bias‑adjusted model includes the effort covariate as a predictor, but the same effort covariate is used as an offset when constructing the target variable (effort‑scaled cumulative‑count thresholds). Evaluating this model’s performance (e.g., via RMSE, Diebold‑Mariano test) therefore tests a predictor that is definitionally embedded in the outcome, creating a circular validation. This violates the independence requirement between predictors and validation targets and can artificially inflate the secondary model’s apparent skill.
